messages:
sasha: PR up https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1587 — update Nova-Embed v2 model card with batching guidance, shard limits and latest bench numbers. Need doc review and SDK snippet for embeddings.

mike: taking a look now, can you paste current bench table here?

sasha: pasted below
```
model | batch=1 | batch=16 | notes
Nova-Embed-v2 | 1200 RPM | 8400 RPM | improved kv cache
```

ana: LGTM on wording, small nit: change 'shard' to 'shard/replica' in the limits paragraph to avoid confusion

jen: compatibility Q — do quantized 4-bit variants keep the same per-batch throughput? I think not, we should add a note.

mike: @jen correct — q4 decreases perf ~10-15% in our bench on A10G; we should add a short sentence and a link to bench artifacts: https://bench.redwood/run/novacard-1587

sasha: thanks — @mike want to add python SDK snippet showing batch_embeddings call with 'batch_size=16' and shard guidance. Example:
```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
c.embeddings.create(model='nova-embed-v2', input=['a','b','c'], batch_size=16)
```

mike: will add and push a follow-up commit. Also updating the YAML example for card limits.

deploy-bot: preview deployed — https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/docs/model-cards/nova-embed-v2 (status: success) :white_check_mark:

ana: I noticed broken relative link to /docs/embeddings/sharding — fixing in same PR

sasha: great. Can someone add a short bench note: 'embedding throughput measured on A10G, batch sizes 1/16, sequences avg 32 tokens' — then we can merge once SDK snippet is in.

mike: done and pushed. Ready for merge on my end if reviewers approve :thumbsup:

jen: approved. :eyes:

sasha: merging in 5 if no objections.

sasha: merged — thanks everyone. changelog note: 'clarified batching guidance and shard limits for Nova-Embed v2; added SDK snippet and bench links.'
